content.short: DTTD is a mobile-first social wallet that helps users access NFTs easily.
content.description: DTTD is a mobile platform designed to lower the entry barrier to NFTs for Web2 users, providing a straightforward onboarding path and a fluid, mobile-first experience. By prioritizing simplicity and accessibility, it aims to make NFT concepts approachable on the go while offering a social layer that reimagines how people discover, engage with, and share NFT-related moments. The result is a seamless, smartphone-oriented way to participate in NFT activities without friction.
